protocol: Train unmasked, test one absent feature family; count=0 and aggregates=NaN; regenerate summaries using training-only thresholds
unmasked_prediction_check: exact match to nested_predictions.csv for every row/model/scope
limitations: Controlled simultaneous group removal, not natural missingness or unseen-dataset validation. Repeated exploratory use of outer folds. Fixed-prediction bootstrap does not include refit uncertainty.
